# Ultha (ultha.co)

> Ultha Moktan is a customer voice partner for SaaS startups. She runs 30-minute calls with a startup's customers as a neutral third party. What customers love becomes proof buyers and AI search trust: testimonials, case studies, customer story videos, UGC and tutorial videos. What customers would change becomes a one-page Insights brief the product and engineering team can act on. Fully remote, one person, start to finish.

About: Former product manager (25+ major launches) and marketer who co-founded a marketing agency that worked with 40+ brands. M.S. in Technology Management from UCSB. Based in Santa Barbara, CA.

## Services
- [Voice of customer insights](https://ultha.co/voice-of-customer): Customer calls, a one-page Insights brief for product and engineering, win-loss studies and churn interviews.
- [Customer stories](https://ultha.co/customer-stories): Testimonials approved by customers, case studies, customer story videos recorded remotely, UGC and tutorial videos, posts and carousels.
- [AI search optimization](https://ultha.co/ai-search): Customer proof set up on the startup's site so AI tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can find and cite it. Also called generative engine optimization.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://ultha.co/pricing): Customer Voice Sprint ($5,000, 30 days), 90-Day Customer Voice Engine ($6,000/month), Keep it running retainer ($3,500/month). Every plan includes customer calls, an Insights brief, customer proof and content. Add-ons: customer calls with an insights brief, customer calls with testimonials, case studies and content, customer story videos, UGC and tutorial videos, win-loss studies, churn interviews.

## Case studies
- [The year buyers stopped Googling software first](https://ultha.co/case-studies/the-year-buyers-stopped-googling): In one year, B2B software buyers who start research in an AI chatbot rose from 29% to 51% (G2); 69% switched vendors because of a chatbot answer.
- [How Salesloft turned customer reviews into $1.8M in pipeline](https://ultha.co/case-studies/salesloft-reviews-pipeline): A scheduled review program and a sales "story flipbook"; $1.82M pipeline and $781K revenue reported by G2.
- [memoryBlue: $800K in pipeline from a steady review habit](https://ultha.co/case-studies/memoryblue-always-on-reviews): Milestone-based review asks and always-on campaigns.

## Guides
- [How to ask customers for reviews (without it being awkward)](https://ultha.co/guides/how-to-ask-customers-for-reviews): When to ask, who should send it, and 3 copy-paste request emails for B2B customers.
- [Stop asking customers "How do you like our product?"](https://ultha.co/guides/stop-asking-how-do-you-like-our-product): 5 interview questions that get customers to tell real, specific stories instead of polite praise.
- [Your best sales pitch is buried in a Zoom recording](https://ultha.co/guides/your-best-sales-pitch-is-buried-in-a-zoom-recording): How to turn one 30-minute customer call into a short video, social clips, a written customer story and a sales one-pager, with customer approval.
